units.source_text: 匂亲王骑着马，站在稍远的地方。

en.t: Prince Niou was on horseback, standing a little way off.

units.source_text: 好几匹声音粗俗的村犬，跑出来向他狂吠，非常可怕。

en.t: Several village dogs with coarse barks ran out and barked furiously at him, which was very frightening.

units.source_text: 几个随从人都很担心，他们想：

en.t: The few attendants were all worried, and they thought:

units.source_text: “我们人数很少，亲王又打扮得这样微贱，

en.t: "There are so few of us, and the prince is dressed in such a humble way,

units.source_text: 倘使走出几个不分皂白的暴徒来，怎么办呢？”

en.t: what will we do if a few reckless ruffians come out without knowing right from wrong?"

units.source_text: 时方只管催促侍从：“快走吧，快走吧！”

en.t: Tokikata only kept urging the attendant, "Go quickly, go quickly!"

units.source_text: 终于带着她来了。

en.t: At last, she brought her there.

units.source_text: 侍从把长长的头发挟在胁下，让发端挂在前面，容姿非常可爱。

en.t: The attendant tucked her long hair under her arm and let the ends hang down in front; her appearance was very charming.

units.source_text: 时方劝她乘马，她一定不肯。

en.t: Tokikata urged her to ride the horse, but she absolutely refused.

units.source_text: 时方便捧着她的长裾，替她当跟班。

en.t: So Tokikata held up the long train of her robe and served as her attendant.

units.source_text: 又把自己的木屐给她穿上，自己穿了同来的仆人那双粗劣的木屐。

en.t: He also gave her his own wooden clogs to wear, while he put on the crude clogs of the servant who had come with them.

units.source_text: 走到匂亲王面前，时方便把情况向他报告。

en.t: When they came before Prince Niou, Tokikata reported the situation to him.

units.source_text: 然而这样地站在那里，谈话也很不方便。

en.t: However, standing there like that made it very inconvenient to talk.

units.source_text: 于是在一所草舍的墙阴下杂草繁茂的地方，铺上一块鞍韂，请匂亲王下马席地而坐。

en.t: So, in a weedy place beneath the shadow of a thatched cottage wall, they spread out a saddle cloth and asked Prince Niou to dismount and sit on the ground.

units.source_text: 匂亲王自己心中寻思：

en.t: Prince Niou thought to himself:

units.source_text: “我这般模样多难看啊！

en.t: "How shameful I look like this!

units.source_text: 眼见得此身将毁损在情场中，不能好好地做人了！”

en.t: It is clear that this body of mine will be ruined in love, and I will no longer be able to live properly as a person!"

units.source_text: 眼泪便流个不住。

en.t: His tears then flowed without stopping.

units.source_text: 侍从心肠很软，看了他这模样更是不胜悲伤。

en.t: The attendant was softhearted, and seeing him in this state made her even more unable to bear her sorrow.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的容姿非常优美，即使是可怕的敌人所变成的鬼看见了，也不忍抛弃。

en.t: Prince Niou was so exquisitely beautiful that even a demon transformed from a fearsome enemy, seeing him, could not bear to abandon him.

units.source_text: 他略微镇静一下，对侍从说道：

en.t: He calmed himself a little and said to the attendant:

units.source_text: “难道连说一句话都不行吗？

en.t: "Am I not even allowed to say a single word?

units.source_text: 为什么戒备忽然森严起来？

en.t: Why has the guard suddenly become so strict?

units.source_text: 想必是有人在薰大将面前毁谤我了。”

en.t: Someone must have slandered me before General Kaoru."

units.source_text: 侍从便把情况详细告诉他，说道：

en.t: The attendant then told him the circumstances in detail, saying:

units.source_text: “不久决定了来迎的日子，务请预先妥善地做好准备。

en.t: "The day for the formal escort will soon be decided, so please make thorough preparations in advance.

units.source_text: 我们看到亲王如此不惜尊严，屡次劳驾，即使粉身碎骨，也必设法玉成其事。”

en.t: Seeing Your Highness set aside your dignity like this and trouble yourself again and again, we will find a way to bring the matter to completion, even if our bodies are ground to dust."

units.source_text: 匂亲王自己也觉得这样子难看，便不怪怨浮舟一方面了。

en.t: Prince Niou himself also felt that his conduct looked shameful, so he no longer blamed Ukifune's side.

units.source_text: 其时夜已很深，与人为难的群犬不断地狂吠，随从人等把它们赶走。

en.t: By then the night was already deep, and the troublesome pack of dogs kept barking furiously, so the attendants drove them away.

units.source_text: 那些守夜人听到了，便拉动弓弦，发出声响。

en.t: The night watchmen heard the noise and drew their bowstrings, making a sharp sound.

units.source_text: 有一个男子怪声怪气地叫喊：“火烛小心！”

en.t: One man cried out in a strange voice, "Take care with fire!"

units.source_text: 匂亲王非常慌张，只得命驾返京，此时他心中的悲伤自不必说。

en.t: Prince Niou became very flustered and had no choice but to order the carriage back to the capital; needless to say, his heart was full of grief.

units.source_text: 对侍从吟道：

en.t: He recited a poem to the attendant:
